regions.today: Today will start off dry in east Leinster. Rain in the west of the province will extend eastwards to all areas by noon. Sunshine and scattered showers will follow through the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees, with light to moderate southerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will bring a mix of clear spells and scattered showers. They'll become isolated overnight. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees with mostly light southwesterly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Sunday will bring bright or sunny spells and well scattered showers. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees with light to moderate west to south-west breezes.
regions.solar_uv: High in sunshine today and Sunday
